steps.en: Add cloudflare/skills as a plugin marketplace, then install the plugin from it
steps.zh: 把 cloudflare/skills 加成插件市场，再从中装插件

steps.en: Adds 16 skills and one entry for Cloudflare's hosted MCP server to the agent
steps.zh: 给 agent 装上 16 个 skill 和一条托管 MCP 服务器配置

steps.en: Say what you want to build in plain words, without naming a product
steps.zh: 用大白话说要搭什么，不用点名产品

steps.en: Maps the need to the Cloudflare product that fits and loads that product's skill
steps.zh: 把需求对到合适的 Cloudflare 产品，加载对应 skill

steps.en: Makes the agent fetch the current docs page and check your installed versions before coding
steps.zh: 让 agent 写代码前先取当前文档页、核对已装版本

component.zh: 产品 SKILL.md + 参考目录

value.en: The agent picks the right Cloudflare product and writes against today's docs instead of stale training memory
value.zh: agent 选对 Cloudflare 产品，按今天的文档写，而不是凭过时的训练记忆

sources: README.md Installing / Claude Code — `/plugin marketplace add cloudflare/skills`, `/plugin install cloudflare@cloudflare`
README.md Skills table (16 skills) and MCP Servers section (only the main `cloudflare` server is bundled)
skills/cloudflare/SKILL.md — need-to-product table, 'Actively surface Cloudflare products…', 'load the relevant skills or documentation'
skills/workers-best-practices/SKILL.md + skills/wrangler/SKILL.md — 'Prefer retrieval over pre-training', use the project's installed versions
CONTRIBUTING.md — skills link to developers.cloudflare.com instead of copying it
